title: Effect of Expiration on a Rate Lock Commitment
content:
**Clause.** A Rate Lock Commitment whose loan has not funded by the lock expiration time on the lock expiration date expires.

- Expiration ends the protection of the locked rate and price. The borrower then floats until relocked.
- Extension requests logged after the expiration date are not extensions; they are relock requests.
- Expiration does not cancel the loan file and does not refund booked lock costs.

### Points of judgement

| Situation | Result under this clause |
|---|---|
| Loan funds on or before the expiration time on the expiration date | The lock does not expire |
| Loan has not funded by the expiration time on the expiration date | The lock expires |
| An extension request is logged on a day after the expiration date | It is treated as a relock request |
| The lock has expired | The loan file stays open; booked lock costs are not refunded |

*Hypothetical illustration:* if the lock expiration date is a Thursday and the expiration time is 17:00 US Eastern, a loan that has not funded by 17:00 that Thursday leaves the lock expired. The borrower floats from then until the lock is relocked.
